findings.category: plain-text mathematical notation in formal statement
findings.exact_claim: If A,B are N×m row-stochastic matrices and M∈[0,1]^{m×m} satisfies (AMBᵀ)_xx≥0.99 and (AMBᵀ)_xy≤0.01 for x≠y, then for every m≥2, N≤exp(60(ln m)²).
findings.finding: The complete formal statement is rendered as ordinary text. The multiplication dimensions, matrix entries, indexed products, inequalities, and logarithmic exponent use raw Unicode/ASCII notation rather than typeset math; adjacent assumptions at line 31 typeset the same notation. This is legible, but the statement has visibly inconsistent mathematical formatting.
findings.suggested_repair: Wrap the mathematical expressions in supported inline MathMarkdown delimiters while preserving the exact claim.

existing_diagram_checks.review_result: The sole assigned diagram is the controlled global-phase two-qubit circuit in cex-qa-37-projective-is-not-controlled. Visual review found its filled control, lower target -I gate, wire connections, and X-basis control readout consistent with the accompanying matrix/state claim. No other assigned item has an existing diagram; absence alone is not a defect.

limitations: Local frozen-render audit only; no HTTP/live site review was performed.
Mathematical review was limited to rendering-sensitive notation, the one existing TikZ diagram, and the two optional source-supported circuit-diagram candidates; this is not a proof audit.
No clipping defect was confirmed. No visible horizontal overflow was called clipping without evidence of content being cut.
The reported statement-formatting finding is a source-authored plain-text notation inconsistency, not a KaTeX parser failure.

candidates.exact_claim: The algorithm prepares target T with X, applies H to T and address A, calls the standard XOR oracle once, applies H to A, then measures A and returns the measured bit.
candidates.why_warranted: The ordered gate sequence and two separate registers are explicit in the procedure; a circuit diagram would show the single oracle query, target phase-kickback preparation, and terminal address measurement at a glance.
candidates.specific_content: Draw address wire A and target wire T from |0>|0>; X on T, H on both wires, one Uf box on the ordered pair (A,T), H on A, then computational-basis measurement of A with output 0/1. Keep the query count at one and indicate no measurement on T.
candidates.evidence_note: The original tile contains the complete instruction list and no diagram; this is an optional instructional visualization.

candidates.exact_claim: Quantum phase estimation initializes an m-qubit phase register and system eigenvector, applies H to each phase wire, controlled U^(2^j) powers with the specified reversed wire indexing, inverse positive-sign QFT, and phase-register measurement.
candidates.why_warranted: The source explicitly assigns control powers to q_(m-1-j), distinguishes inverse QFT from U inverse, and states the coherent prefix before measurement; a labeled register-level diagram could expose these conventions compactly.
candidates.specific_content: Show m phase wires q_(m-1),...,q_0 and the system wire H; H gates on every phase wire; controlled powers U^(1),U^2,...,U^(2^(m-1)) with the source-mandated control index q_(m-1-j); an inverse positive-sign QFT box on phase wires; and measurement/output y/Q. Label that inverse QFT is not a controlled U^-1 call.
candidates.evidence_note: Both original tiles show the complete procedure and remarks; no diagram is present. Candidate only; the prose already specifies the circuit.
